caption: Fort Sint Pieter, Maastricht
composition: Low five-sided brick-and-marl fort above the city · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Fort Sint Pieter is the five-sided fort of 1701-1702 on the north side of the Sint-Pietersberg. The walls are thick, with marl below and brick above, and two rows of loopholes. It is not a castle with round towers. It is clear, about 14.0°C, with wind near 11.5 km/h and cloud cover about 6%. The interior is closed. The caves are not the subject. Vrijthof and the other Maastricht churches are not in this frame.
